Click a source to take it on or off air. The monitor runs on demo data; your links use the live wheel.

Sources

Each overlay is its own OBS browser source, so you can place, size and hide them separately. Copy a link, then add it in OBS.

Adding a source in OBS

Works the same in Streamlabs, Twitch Studio and vMix: look for "Browser source" or "Web page".

  1. Copy the link of the overlay you want.
  2. In OBS, open Sources, press + and choose Browser.
  3. Paste the link into URL and enter the width and height shown next to the overlay.
  4. Tick Control audio via OBS to mix the sounds, then drag the overlay into place.

Where the data comes from

Your OBS reads Squeekchain's public API every few seconds. Run alerts follow the wheel sensor; block banners and chat calls follow the rounds settled on Sepolia, so nobody can fake a result.

What Wheelcast keeps

Nothing on a server. Chat is read anonymously and never posted to. Prediction streaks live in your OBS browser, per channel. The pages load the Barlow typeface from Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com). Squeektoshi's wheel time is never forced or encouraged.

Wheelcast is a free community tool built on Squeekchain's public API. Made by serkan @serkankels
